native_discovery.source_program:
"""Local integration observation of unchanged official skill source bytes.

Sources: OpenHands/software-agent-sdk@dcf401af7a9a302ef92cb7d092e1df9bb659daa5
openhands-sdk/openhands/sdk/skills/skill.py:1049-1142,1453-1533.
This does not install a skill, construct an agent, invoke a skill, or call a model.
"""

import importlib.metadata
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys
from xml.etree import ElementTree

from openhands.sdk.skills.skill import load_project_skills, to_prompt


base = Path(sys.argv[1])
expected = json.loads((base / "expected.json").read_text())
assert importlib.metadata.version("openhands-sdk") == "1.50.0"

# Discriminating control: the same native loader must see no project skills.
control = load_project_skills(base / "control")
assert control == [], [skill.name for skill in control]
print("control: native project loader returned 0 skills")

target = base / ("control" if "--control-as-target" in sys.argv else "project")
skills = load_project_skills(target)
names = sorted(skill.name for skill in skills)
if names != expected:
    print(f"qualification rejected: expected {len(expected)} skills, discovered {len(names)}")
    raise SystemExit(1)
prompt = to_prompt(skills)
xml = ElementTree.fromstring(prompt)
assert sorted(node.text for node in xml.findall("skill/name")) == expected
assert len(xml.findall("skill/description")) == len(expected)
assert xml.findall(".//location") == []
assert all(skill.description for skill in skills)
assert all(skill.content and skill.content not in prompt for skill in skills)
print(f"selected: native project loader returned {len(skills)} expected skills")
print("prompt: names/descriptions only; no location or full skill bodies")
print("provider request and native invoke_skill were not executed")

result = {
    "sdk_version": importlib.metadata.version("openhands-sdk"),
    "tools_version": importlib.metadata.version("openhands-tools"),
    "control_discovered_count": len(control),
    "selected_discovered_count": len(skills),
    "selected_names_match": names == expected,
    "prompt_name_count": len(xml.findall("skill/name")),
    "prompt_description_count": len(xml.findall("skill/description")),
    "prompt_location_count": len(xml.findall(".//location")),
    "full_skill_bodies_in_metadata_prompt": 0,
    "metadata_prompt_utf8_bytes": len(prompt.encode()),
    "selected_names": names,
    "native_invocation_evidence": "not_collected",
    "provider_usage": None,
}
(base / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
